name: consistency-violation-mapping-set-pointer-mapped
description: `[constr_1066]`'s refusal, and the one pairing `examples/create-implementation-composites-and-composite-map.json` never writes: an application type mapped onto a pointer. The pointer loads and the mapping set loads — both of its sides resolve to declared data types — so what refuses is the model rule that an application data type is never mapped to an implementation data type of category `DATA_REFERENCE`.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model, whose `implementation_types` layer holds the value type `uint16`. The change set creates an application type, a pointer to `uint16` and a mapping set whose one pair maps the first onto the second.

authorization.notes: The scope covers the three addresses exactly, so the refusal is the model rule and not the authorization boundary.

input.intent: Store the wheel speed behind a reference.

expected.notes: One address, the pair's `implementation` side, which is the repair: re-point it at an implementation type that stores the value, or remove the pair. The pointer itself is legal and stays so — it may be an argument's type or another pointer's target — and only mapping one is refused. The rule is checked before the mapping-set kind rules, so a map onto a pointer is this one finding and never an `unknown-implementation` one besides. SWCraft applies the same refusal to a pointer reached through a reference type or inside an implementation record or array the pair names; the direct pair is the one the constraint's text states.
